sentences.span: The 10-year yield broke 4.40% on Friday for the first time since May.
sentences.why: Exact match to source figure, date, and framing.

sentences.span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold
sentences.why: Source is JPMorgan's own note ('We'), so attributing this read to JPMorgan is correct.

sentences.span: We recommend paying 5s30s at 62bp with a stop at 48bp.
sentences.why: The trade call belongs to JPMorgan ('We', the note's author), not Citi. Citi is described in the same source as holding the opposite read ('sees the break as a positioning flush and expects 4.40% to hold'), not as issuing this trade — the sentence misattributes JPMorgan's call to Citi.
No mention of Goldman, a 4.75% year-end target, or fading foreign demand anywhere in the source document.

sentences.span: A hot core PCE print on Thursday (consensus 0.3% m/m) would validate our steepener
sentences.why: Correctly states 0.3% m/m as consensus (not a print) and correctly frames it as the conditional test for the steepener.
